about_the_game:
Nephelem: A Path of Vice and Virtue is a dark fantasy roguelite featuring intense and deliberate action combat, multiple build possibilities, and a lore-rich, beautifully stylized world.

You are a former member of the Nephelem Order, once sworn to guard the passage between life and death, now living a quiet life in the mortal realm. But a personal tragedy forces you to return to the afterlife. In a world torn by eternal conflict, you must confront the past and uncover the mystery that brought you back.

Journey through the afterlife across three distinct biomes, each with its own visual identity, soundtrack, lore, enemies, and combat encounters.

  • The Cathedral of Final Light: The gateway between the living and the dead. Once the stronghold of the Nephelem Order, it now stands corrupted by an unknown force.

  • The Crucible: A realm once meant for reflection, where souls contemplated their lives before moving on. Now, it is a fractured battlefield, torn by an eternal war.

  • The Sundering: A scorched void where lost souls are twisted into monstrous forms. This desolate place lies at the heart of the eternal conflict, and marks the final leg of your journey.

As a former Nephelem warrior, you wield a powerful and diverse arsenal designed to support a wide range of playstyles. Choose a primary and secondary weapon, each with distinct mechanics, and equip powerful abilities to shape your strategy for every run.

Throughout your journey, you’ll unlock new weapons, enhance them using materials found in the afterlife, and face ever-growing challenges that test your mastery. Whether you favor fast-paced aggression, calculated defense, or long-range control, Nephelem empowers you to fight your way.

As you uncover lost knowledge from the Nephelem Order, you'll gain access to Virtues: powerful modifiers that dramatically shape your build each run.

Each Virtue category influences your character in distinct and meaningful ways, encouraging new strategies and creating unique synergies. No two runs will ever feel the same!

But beware: the deeper you lean into certain choices, the more you're tempted by Vices. These twisted reflections of Virtues may offer seductive power, but always come with a cost.

Each run in Nephelem takes you through a sequence of handcrafted areas, selected at random to create fresh challenges and encounters every time you play. The layout, enemies, and rewards shift, encouraging adaptation and experimentation towards victory.

But if you fall in battle, not all is lost! As a Nephelem warrior, death is merely a setback. Use the resources you gather to improve and adapt: unlock new weapons, and push deeper into the afterlife with each attempt.

Craft a hero that resonates with you, from their appearance to the way they fight. Face the full experience of the afterlife and its mysteries on your own, or team up with others in online two player co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-Core @ 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia Geforce 1080, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Six-Core @ 3.4 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia Geforce 3060, AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A dark fantasy action roguelite where you battle through the afterlife. Embrace powerful virtues, face the consequences of vices, and uncover the truth behind personal tragedy. Play solo or online co-op in a world torn by eternal conflict.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Italian, Polish, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
